text:
1. I made an appointment two weeks in advance. Online, they confirmed it could be done on the same day. However, when I arrived, they said they had no record of my booking. I was made to wait for 1.5 hours, was still charged a consultation fee, and the dentist only saw me for about 30sec before asking me to come back two days later, saying the treatment couldn’t be done that day.
2. For my second appointment, I was again made to wait for 1.5 hours.
3. The pricing was inconsistent. After examining my teeth, the dentist said my case was not complicated and that all four wisdom teeth could be removed in one session at 3,000 THB per tooth. In reality, the dentist spent 1.5 hours removing just one tooth, then said that was enough, and charged me 4,000 THB for that single extraction.

4. I have four wisdom teeth with minor decay. I originally wanted them to be filled, but the dentist insisted that all four needed to be removed. After extracting just one tooth, the dentist refused to provide any further treatment or alternatives for the remaining teeth, leaving my cavities untreated.

5. During the extraction, the dentist was very rough. The procedure took 1.5 hours and even caused a cut on my lip and    palate. After the surgery, I was given no aftercare instructions at all, just told to pay and leave.

I have never experienced such poor dental service before. I honestly don’t understand how this clinic has a 4.8 star rating. Please avoid this place.

text:
I was visiting from abroad and needed some dental work done. I went to BIDC Main on Ratchadaphisek Road for a teeth cleaning and several cavity fillings, and I had a wonderful experience from start to finish.

The clinic was exceptionally clean, and every staff member—from the receptionists and nurses who took my vital signs to the dentist—was professional, welcoming, and genuinely kind. They patiently answered all of my questions, and because the staff spoke excellent English, communication was easy and stress-free. I was able to get my treatment done in the same day.

My dentist, Dr. Nonthapan, was incredibly thorough and detail-oriented. She took the time to explain each procedure, why it was necessary, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. She was meticulous with my fillings and ensured my teeth looked and felt just right before I left. The aftercare instructions were clear, easy to understand, and very helpful. I felt completely safe and confident in her care.

Her assistant, Rin, was also wonderful—kind, attentive, and supportive throughout the entire process.

I highly recommend BIDC Main to anyone, especially international visitors looking for high-quality dental care in Bangkok. I will definitely return here for any future dental needs whenever I’m in Bangkok.

-Amina

After this session I tried to change to another dentist but there was no option with my schedule so I came back a second time to the same - my mistake.

She suggested I didn’t need to numb one of the areas for a filling - I have no idea why I went with this - I asked her to stop as the pain was too much - she said 2 more minutes - after 2 minutes the area continued to be sore and sensitive while she continued her work. Aside from that the second session was much better.

I have more work to do but am now looking to complete it at another dentist - I see great review here perhaps I am just unlucky.
